requirement_en: Product name on the principal display panel that identifies it as a "dietary supplement" (the word "dietary" may be replaced by the ingredient, e.g. "collagen supplement").
how_to_check_ko: 앞면 텍스트에 'supplement'가 포함된 제품명이 있는지

requirement_en: Net quantity of contents stated as weight, volume or count; weight/volume in both metric and US customary units, e.g. 280 g (9.9 oz) or 14 sticks.
how_to_check_ko: 'Net Wt', 'oz', 'g', 'count' 패턴 인식, 미터법·미국 단위 둘 다 있는지

requirement_en: Net quantity in the bottom 30% of the principal display panel, in lines generally parallel to the base.
how_to_check_ko: 라벨 이미지에서 내용량 텍스트 위치가 앞면 하단 30% 안인지

requirement_en: Minimum type height for net quantity depends on PDP area: 1/16 in (≤5 sq in), 1/8 in (5–25), 3/16 in (25–100), 1/4 in (100–400), 1/2 in (>400).
how_to_check_ko: 앞면 면적과 글자 높이 입력값으로 계산

requirement_en: If the package has an alternate principal display panel, statement of identity and net quantity are repeated there.
how_to_check_ko: 포장 전개도에 앞면이 2개 이상이면 두 항목 반복 여부
applies_when: package has an alternate front panel

requirement_en: Information panel is immediately to the right of the principal display panel (or next panel to the right if unusable).
how_to_check_ko: 포장 전개도 기준 정보 패널 위치

requirement_en: Panel titled "Supplement Facts" in bold, larger than all other print in the panel.
how_to_check_ko: 'Supplement Facts' 텍스트 존재, 패널 내 최대 크기인지

requirement_en: Serving size followed by servings per container.
how_to_check_ko: 'Serving Size', 'Servings Per Container' 인식

requirement_en: Amount per serving for each listed nutrient present above zero thresholds (calories, fats, carbohydrate, sugars, added sugars, protein, vitamin D, calcium, iron, potassium, etc.), with %DV where a Daily Value exists.
how_to_check_ko: 성분별 함량·%DV 열이 있는지, 한국 라벨 영양정보와 수치 대조

requirement_en: Dietary ingredients without a Daily Value (e.g. collagen) listed by common name with metric amount, marked † "Daily Value not established".
how_to_check_ko: DV 없는 원료 옆 '†' 및 'Daily Value not established' 문구
applies_when: product contains ingredients without a Daily Value

requirement_en: Footnote "Percent Daily Values are based on a 2,000 calorie diet." when calories or fat/carbohydrate/protein-type nutrients are declared.
how_to_check_ko: 각주 문구 존재 여부
applies_when: panel declares calories, fat, carbohydrate or protein

requirement_en: Boxed with hairlines and bars; nutrient text at least 8 pt, headings and footnotes at least 6 pt (4.5 pt allowed on small packages).
how_to_check_ko: 인쇄 사양 입력값 확인 (이미지로는 판정 어려움)

requirement_en: Ingredients not in the Supplement Facts panel listed below it, preceded by "Other ingredients", in descending order of weight.
how_to_check_ko: 패널 아래 'Other ingredients' 목록 존재, 한국 원재료명과 대조

requirement_en: Name and place of business of manufacturer, packer or distributor (street, city, state, ZIP); if not the manufacturer, qualified as "Distributed by" / "Manufactured for".
how_to_check_ko: 'Distributed by' 등 표현과 주소 패턴

requirement_en: A domestic US address or US phone number (with area code) for reporting serious adverse events. Without it the product is misbranded.
how_to_check_ko: 미국 주소 또는 미국 국번 전화번호 패턴

requirement_en: The 9 major food allergens (milk, eggs, fish, crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame) declared in the ingredient list or in a "Contains:" statement.
how_to_check_ko: 원재료에서 알레르기 성분 추출 후 'Contains:' 문구와 대조

requirement_en: Fish and crustacean shellfish name the species; tree nuts name the type (e.g. "Contains: Fish (cod)").
how_to_check_ko: 어류·갑각류·견과류 원료에 종 이름이 붙어 있는지
applies_when: product contains fish, shellfish or tree nuts

requirement_en: Required information in type at least 1/16 inch (1.6 mm, lowercase o), with no unrelated material (e.g. barcode) between required items on the information panel.
how_to_check_ko: 인쇄 사양 입력값 + 정보 패널 안 바코드 위치

requirement_en: All required information appears in English; if any required statement is in another language, all required information must also appear in that language.
how_to_check_ko: 한국어 문구가 있으면 필수 항목이 한국어로도 모두 있는지

requirement_en: Structure/function claims carry, in bold type at least 1/16 inch, next to the claim or linked by a symbol and boxed: "This statement has not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease."
how_to_check_ko: 'supports', 'helps' 등 기능 표현 감지 시 면책 문구·기호 연결 확인

requirement_en: No express or implied claim to diagnose, treat, cure, mitigate or prevent a disease (this makes the product a drug).
how_to_check_ko: 'cure', 'treat', 'prevent', 질병명 등 위험 표현 감지

requirement_en: Notify FDA within 30 days after first marketing a product with a structure/function claim. Not a label item; shown as a reminder.
how_to_check_ko: 라벨로는 판정 불가, 체크리스트에 안내로 표시

requirement_en: Nutrients present at amounts that can be declared as zero (e.g. Total Fat 0 g) are not listed in Supplement Facts, unless a claim is made about them.
how_to_check_ko: 함량이 0인 항목이 표에 있는지

requirement_en: Total Sugars have no Daily Value, so no %DV is shown next to Total Sugars.
how_to_check_ko: Sugars 행에 %DV가 있는지

requirement_en: Nutrients use the US names and spelling: Total Fat, Total Carbohydrate, Total Sugars, Riboflavin, Niacin, Pantothenic Acid, Thiamin; "Servings Per Container". A synonym such as "Vitamin B2" may follow in parentheses, and the source goes after "as" (e.g. Pantothenic Acid (as calcium pantothenate)).
how_to_check_ko: 행 이름과 Servings 문구를 미국 표준 이름과 대조

requirement_en: Calories are declared as a number without a unit ("Calories 25"), not "25 kcal".
how_to_check_ko: Calories 행에 kcal 등 단위가 있는지

requirement_en: Nutrients appear in the FDA order: Calories, Total Fat, (Saturated, Trans), Cholesterol, Sodium, Total Carbohydrate, Dietary Fiber, Total Sugars, Added Sugars, Protein, then vitamins and minerals.
how_to_check_ko: 인식한 행 순서를 표준 순서와 비교

requirement_en: Every symbol used in the %DV column (*, †) is explained by a footnote that starts with the same symbol, e.g. "† Daily Value not established."
how_to_check_ko: 표에서 쓴 기호가 각주에 같은 기호로 있는지

requirement_en: Amounts use US label units (g, mg, mcg). Units such as NE, RE, α-TE or IU are not used for vitamins.
how_to_check_ko: 함량에 NE, RE, α-TE, IU가 있는지

requirement_en: Country of origin in English, legible, conspicuous and permanent, e.g. "Made in Korea" or "Product of Korea".
how_to_check_ko: 'Made in Korea' / 'Product of Korea' 문구 존재
